name: SQL Formatter
description: Beautify and minify SQL with keyword casing, indentation and PostgreSQL / SQL Server dialects
help: Supports generic SQL, PostgreSQL (arrays, $$ strings) and SQL Server ([identifiers], @variables).
Keywords can be uppercased, lowercased or preserved; “Compact” keeps short argument lists on one line.
Minify removes comments and collapses whitespace while leaving strings and quoted identifiers untouched.
